main_measure.name: OLS slope of forward 72-bar excess return on forecast (forecast > 0 grid bars)
main_measure.threshold: slope t >= 2 confirms (with supporting check), t <= -2 rejects; at least 100 grid cases with forecast > 0

supporting_check.name: mean excess 72-bar return of top third of forecast > 0

decided_by: The slope's t is 2.63 (>= 2) and the top third's mean excess return is above 0.
reading: Grid is positions 0, 72, 144, ... of each window; the coin's mean 72-bar return is the mean over all its grid bars in all windows; top third is forecast at or above its 2/3 quantile among the positive-forecast samples.
